title: Check for the new german "Datenschutz Grundverordnung" privacy law issues
body:
End of month a new german law comes into effect. The so called "Datenschutz Grundverordnung". A crazy privacy law which for example more or less forbids the embedding of social medias into webpages. This affects Youtube Videos, but also linked images. This means most probably that i have to deactivate the image tag here in the forum. And just allow attached images.

I am still unsure what to do with my video tutorial section. I have a whole bunch of youtube tutorials embedded in the Wiki. For now i have set a privacy warning. But i guess i have to remove the videos.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
Hm, there is a way to embedd youtube videos without cookies. But it is still not sure if this is conform.

German article regarding the issue: https://www.blogmojo.de/youtube-videos-datenschutzkonform-einbetten/

comments.body: Changed the links at the page of the embedded youtube videos to youtube-nocookie links. I can simply not delete our documentation. That would be crazy.

Added a annoying cookie compliance banner to the page.

I have catched what i can catch. I will not remove external images. They are essential. Closing.

comments.author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body:
Changed a few things again. No Recaptcha for now. Privacy Policy is a own page now. And changed the text a bit more. 

For now i am through. So closing again.
